Welcome to DMM
About the College
Established on 24th July, 1981, Digboi Mahila Mahavidyalaya stands as a beacon of women’s education in Upper Assam. Located in the historic oil town of Digboi, the college was founded with a visionary goal: to empower women through access to quality higher education in a region where such opportunities were once scarce. 
Over the decades, the college has grown into a premier institution, known for its academic rigor, cultural vibrancy, and commitment to social upliftment. It has played a transformative role in shaping the lives of countless young women—instilling confidence, fostering intellectual growth, and nurturing leadership. 
Despite challenges, Digboi Mahila Mahavidyalaya has consistently set benchmarks in university results, co-curricular achievements, and community engagement. The institution prides itself on a dedicated faculty, inclusive learning environment, and a student-centric approach that encourages holistic development. 
With a strong foundation in values and a forward-looking vision, the college continues to evolve—embracing innovation while honoring tradition. It remains deeply committed to its mission of educating, empowering, and elevating women, preparing them to meet the demands of a dynamic world with grace and grit.
Affiliated with Dibrugarh University, the college offers Higher Secondary and Undergraduate programmes in Arts, along with skill-based and value-added courses. The institution is committed to empowering women by providing an inclusive learning environment supported by experienced faculty members and modern academic facilities.

Message from the Principal
Principal's Desk
Welcome to Digboi Mahila Mahavidyalaya.

Since its establishment in 1981, our institution has remained committed to empowering women through quality education, ethical values, and holistic development. We strive to create an academic environment that nurtures curiosity, innovation, leadership, and social responsibility.
Our dedicated faculty members work tirelessly to inspire students to achieve academic excellence while encouraging participation in cultural, sports, community service, and research activities. We believe education is not merely about acquiring knowledge but about shaping responsible citizens capable of contributing positively to society.
I warmly invite you to become a part of the Digboi Mahila Mahavidyalaya family and join us in our journey towards excellence.
Dr. Sanjita Chetia
Principal
